The report separately covers runtime operation latency and development-cycle cost; unavailable Contract-to-reviewable, verification-to-finish, or post-merge cleanup samples remain unavailable rather than zero.
Focused performance tests and documentation gates pass; this Work Item does not publish a release.
The three-language Work Item projection and reference-parity rows remain synchronized before archive.
